result.summary: Toolchain verified on-pin (asdf: elixir 1.20.3-otp-29 / erlang 29.0.5, matching .tool-versions exactly, not off-pin). mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force: 180 files, 0 warnings, exit 0. mix test test/letflow/simulation/req206_swiftroute_test.exs: 6/6 passed in 7.8s (all REQ-206's own tests). Full suite via TEST_PARALLEL_N=4 scripts/test_parallel.sh: 2988/2993 passed, 5 failures (2 CheckToolchainTest rustc-ENOENT, 3 RequirementStatusInvariantsTest docs-vocabulary/count drift on requirement_status.v7.yaml -- ISS-0388-related). Independently verified (not just taking the prior handoff's word) via `git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat`: REQ-206's branch makes ZERO changes to test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_toolchain_test.exs, lib/mix/tasks/letflow.check_toolchain.ex, test/docs/requirement_status_invariants_test.exs, or docs/status/requirement_status.v7.yaml -- so all 5 failing tests' content on this branch is byte-identical to main's, making them pre-existing by construction, not introduced by REQ-206. Also ran mix letflow.check.test per the anti-patterns.md ISS-0069 mandate: it raised on the same 5 known pre-existing failures before reaching its own dead-default-arg substring check, so I independently grepped all 4 full-suite partition logs for the gated substring ("default values for the optional arguments") -- zero matches. All warnings actually present belong to already-documented deferred classes (ExUnit.Case.register_test/4 deprecation, redefining-module test workaround, unused alias/var/function, an intentional negative-path type mismatch and never-matches clause) -- none are ISS-0069's class. No WASM HostApiTest failures were observed in this run at all (0 failures in that file across all 4 partitions). Full detail in test/reports/report-2026-09-01-WF02-REQ206-20260901.yaml.
